feature: Drawing viewer annotations and linked-item workflows

flows.name: Viewer baseline and core annotations
flows.expectedOutcome: Viewer controls work, annotations persist, and edits are reflected after reload

flows.name: Link existing records
steps: Exercise existing-record selection for RFI, document, photo, submittal, punch list item, drawing, coordination issue, and task
flows.expectedOutcome: Each advertised type can be selected, linked, persisted, and read back

flows.name: Create new linked records
steps: Create a new RFI, document, photo, submittal, punch list item, drawing, coordination issue, and task where supported
Reload linked drawing and inspect relation
flows.expectedOutcome: Each advertised create flow completes with a specific success state and persisted relation

flows.name: Failure and recovery
flows.expectedOutcome: Failures are explicit, actionable, and do not report success without persistence

flows.name: Responsive visual review
steps: Open annotation/link/create panels at each viewport
flows.expectedOutcome: Controls remain reachable, content is not clipped, and hierarchy follows the design system

checks: Loading and error states are visible
No duplicate or decorative UI noise

claims.description: Existing links tested for all eight requested record types
New linked-item creation tested for all supported requested record types
Existing durable regression coverage inventoried or gap recorded
